concepts.statement_en: Given a community case, identify a non-medical barrier and one health promotion action within the BHW role.
Given a resident's concern, ask, listen, check understanding, and agree a next step.
Given two audience segments and one approved health claim, choose a message/channel/material suited to each.
Given a local hazard briefing, relay a verified action without speculation and identify the official update channel.
Given community feedback, log the concern without identifiable gossip and return it to the appropriate team.
